resources.string: Use sleep summaries for workout suggestions

Use fresh, manually synced sleep summaries to suggest a shorter existing workout. The comparison needs at least 3 prior recorded days synced at similar times. Records may be incomplete and cannot assess recovery.\n\nYour baseline and last 20 explanations stay on this device for your account and are excluded from backup. Turning this off clears both. You can keep your usual workout. Calorie goals, nutrient targets, heart-rate data and exercise calories stay the same.
